title: On a class of supraconvergent Hermite-type methods for advection-diffusion equations
summary: We develop and analyze a class of Hermite-type methods for linear advection-diffusion equations in the case of one-dimensional periodic domains. The methods evolve both nodal values and cell averages and are therefore referred to as hybrid-variable (HV) methods. Using Hermite interpolation theory, we construct the HV methods to arbitrary order of accuracy, and prove that the method is supraconvergent in the sense that the spatial order of accuracy can be up to two orders larger than the local truncation error.
